question: What is India’s rank in the world when GDP is compared in terms of purchasing power parity as on 2019 given by World Population Review Report?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Fifth.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A US-based think tank **World Population Review** in its report said that **India is developing into an open-market economy.**
 
• The report said that India’s economy is the** fifth-largest** in the world with a **GDP of $2.94 trillion in 2019**.
 
• India has gone past the** UK ($2.83 trillion)** and **France($2.91 trillion)** in 2019 to take** the fifth spot..**
 
• The top** 4 countries** above India as per the report are the **USA($21.44 trillion), China( $14.14 trillion), Japan ($5.15 trillion), and Germany ($4 trillion)** respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The report further stated that in terms of the **purchasing power parity (PPP), India’s GDP (PPP) is about $10.51 trillion, more than that of Japan and Germany.**
 
• Due to India’s high population,** India’s GDP per capita is $2,170.**
 
• The report acknowledged that India’s economic liberalization began in the early 1990s and included industrial deregulation, reduced control on foreign trade and investment, and privatization of state-owned enterprises which are the primary reasons for this growth of the country.
 
• The report also found out that **India’s service sector** is the **fast-growing sector** in the world **accounting for almost 60% of the economy** and about **28% of employment**, apart from adding that manufacturing and agriculture are two other significant sectors of the economy.
 
• The **US-based World Population Review** is an **independent organization** that doesn't have any political affiliations.
